{{Quote|It's working, Empress! We're taking back the fleet!|the Knight to [[Emperor/Legends|Eternal Empress]] [[Vaylin]]|<ref name="Chapter 5" />}}
During the [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] by the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], '''a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' served in the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3630 BBY]], the [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]] [[SCORPIO]] [[Assault on the Gravestone|seized control]] of both the Eternal Empire's automated [[Eternal Fleet]] and the ''[[Gravestone]]'', the Alliance's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], having recognized both as being similar to her design. Using information pieced together from all three, she led the fleet and the ''Gravestone'' to the artificial habitat of [[Iokath]], where they were initially constructed. Upon landing, Iokath's caretaker [[ARIES]] attacked Alliance and Eternal Empire members, and this Knight was among the few survivors. Hiding away with a few other Knights, the [[GEMINI]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] captains of the [[Eternal Fleet warship]]s, and [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Eternal Empire military]], they were discovered by [[Emperor/Legends|Eternal Empress]] [[Vaylin]].

==Biography==
[[File:KnightsofZakuul.png|thumb|right|230px|The Knights of Zakuul, in which this Knight served]]
This Knight served in the [[Knights of Zakuul]],<ref name="Chapter 5" /> an organization of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitives]] that served as warriors for the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Knights of Zakuul">{{TORcite|type=codex|Knights of Zakuul}}</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="KOTET dates">{{TOR_updates|5.0}}</ref> Eternal Empress [[Vaylin]] of the Eternal Empire and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[SCORPIO]], planned an [[Assault on the Gravestone|assault]] on the ''[[Gravestone]]'', the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] that was [[War against Zakuul|rebelling]] against the Eternal Empire. During the operation SCORPIO betrayed Vaylin and revealed her true intentions-to use information pieced together from herself, the files of the Eternal Empire's automated [[Eternal Fleet]], and the computer core of the ''Gravestone'', to take all three to [[Iokath|their point of origin]].<ref name="Chapter 3">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=3}}</ref>

===Trapped on Iokath===
The point of origin was revealed to be an uninhabited artificial structure called [[Iokath]] that was constructed by the [[Unidentified Iokath species|same species]] that had built SCORPIO, the ''Gravestone'', and the Eternal Fleet. SCORPIO escaped to the surface in a [[Ridala|starship]], while the Eternal Fleet and the ''Gravestone'' docked on Iokath. Members of the Alliance and the forces of the Eternal Empire, including the Knight, were ejected from their ships and faced hostilities from [[ARIES]], a droid who had become Iokath's self-appointed caretaker following the [[Iokath Civil War|civil war]] that had resulted in the extinction of Iokath's creators. The Knight was among a group of Zakuulan Knights, [[Eternal Empire military]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]], and [[GEMINI]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who took refuge from ARIES' forces in a room near the [[Fleet Spire|spire]] where the Eternal Fleet was docked.<ref name="Chapter 5" />

[[File:Yaymoreiokath.png|thumb|left|230px|The Knight, to the left of Vaylin, kneels before his Empress]]
While there, the Knight knelt in the middle of the group and listened to an [[Unidentified Eternal Empire officer (Iokath)|officer]] lament their situation, believing they would not survive. At that moment, Empress Vaylin arrived and took control of the group, though [[Gender/Legends|she]] was displeased to see that very few survived ARIES' attacks. A [[Unidentified GEMINI unit|GEMINI droid]] expressed fear at the situation, and Vaylin destroyed it to motivate everyone else, taking the officer and [[Unidentified GEMINI unit (Iokath) 2|another GEMINI]] to a console.

===Retaking the fleet===
{{Quote|Empress, we've recaptured half the fleet.''"<br />"''We'll tow the remaining ships with tractor beams.''"<br />"''But we still can't penetrate that energy shield. This droid knows all about ARIES. Connect to its datacore and get me answers.|The Knight, the officer, and Vaylin|<ref name="Chapter 5" />}}
[[File:The_helmetless_Knight.png|thumb|right|230px|The Knight reports to Vaylin]]
The Knight was watching the Eternal Fleet from a nearby balcony, and reported to Vaylin with some surprise that the fleet was back online after they reactivated it. Following the reactivation, the Knight, along with the officer and the GEMINI, made their way to the bridge of one of the warships. Vaylin followed, dragging half of a [[Unidentified Purifier droid|Purifier droid]] behind her. The Knight reported that half the fleet had been reactivated, and the officer reported that the rest could be towed. Vaylin ignored them and had the GEMINI slice into the [[Purifier droid|droid]] to locate ARIES, using the information gained to bombard [[ARIES base|his base]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />

==Personality and traits==
The Knight had fair skin, dark hair, and brown eyes, and was of the average size of a Knight of Zakuul. He expressed surprise when Vaylin's attempt to release the Eternal Fleet worked.
